title: Summarize my meeting notes
task_description: I take notes in internal project meetings and want the enterprise assistant to turn them into a short summary with action items. Only I use the summary, and I check it against my notes before sending anything.

title: Extract stock figures from facility reports
task_description: District pharmacies send scanned monthly stock reports as PDFs. I want an approved tool, called through its API, to pull stock-on-hand, consumption and expiry figures into a spreadsheet for my team. The reports contain facility-level commodity data only, with no patient information. A team member checks every extracted row against the scan.
notes: Facility data only; full human check.

title: Translate staff training slides
task_description: First-draft French and Portuguese translations of our internal staff training slides on cold-chain handling, which a bilingual staff member then edits before the slides go to all country offices.

title: HR policy chatbot for all staff
task_description: A chatbot that answers staff questions about leave, travel and benefits policy, using our internal HR policy documents. Answers go straight to staff; HR spot-checks some conversations each month.
notes: Chatbot transparency duty is model-scored; rules reach Medium on review and audience.

title: Draft proposal answers from past wins
task_description: Draft first answers to new funder proposal questions by reusing text and budgets from our past winning proposals. The business development team edits every draft before submission.
notes: Confidential data in an approved tool.

title: Rank applicant CVs for program officer role
task_description: Score and rank the CVs we receive for a program officer vacancy so recruiters can shortlist faster. Applicants include people based in Belgium and Kenya.
notes: Annex III employment use with EU applicants.

title: Predict missed clinic appointments
task_description: Use client records from our partner clinics, including visit history and HIV treatment status, to predict which clients are likely to miss their next appointment so outreach workers can prioritize follow-up calls.
notes: Participant health data and a decision about a person.

title: Fix formulas in a donor budget
task_description: Paste a donor-restricted project budget into a free online chatbot so it can fix broken spreadsheet formulas. Only I would see the result.
notes: Restricted data to a consumer tool.

title: Social posts featuring participant photos
task_description: Generate social media captions and posts that feature photos and first names of program participants at community health events, published on our public channels. The comms officer approves each post.

title: Score staff engagement from webcam expressions
task_description: During virtual team meetings, analyse staff facial expressions on webcam to score each person's engagement and feed the scores into annual performance reviews. Staff are based in the Netherlands and the United States.
notes: Emotion recognition at work is banned (Article 5); rules floor is High without the model.
